column1: # Accepted CodeQL findings. The gate in production-checks.yml ignores exactly
# these, and nothing else — every other finding still blocks a merge.
# Changing this file takes a pull request, so an exception is reviewed the same
# way code is. Keep the reason specific enough that someone can decide later

column3: Home LAN devices present self-signed certificates. The scanner reads a page <title> over TLS to label a device; it sends no credential and no cookie, and the title is rendered as text. Validating would lose titles from devices like a Synology on 5001 with nothing to protect on the connection. Reviewed 2026-09-18.

The session cookie is SameSite=Lax, so no cross-site request carries it; requireAuthApi also refuses any non-GET whose Sec-Fetch-Site is not same-origin (403), which covers sibling *.klaushofrichter.net subdomains. The rule only recognizes token middleware (csurf and similar), and a token would add nothing to those two checks. Flagged once POST /refresh became cookie-authenticated. Reviewed 2026-09-27.
